title: 14 Questions To Ask Yourself Before The First Day Of School https://smartclassroommanagement.com/2018/07/21/questions-to-ask-before-the-first-day-of-school/
author: Michael Linsin
summary: Linsin offers a fourteen-question self-assessment designed to test a teacher's readiness and commitment before the first day of school, covering areas like whether rules are simple and enforceable, whether the teacher knows exactly what does and doesn't break each rule, whether they're committed to consistent enforcement, and whether their syllabus clearly communicates consequences to parents. He recommends answering quickly on gut instinct first, then reviewing any 'no' or 'not sure' answers to identify what changes are needed to turn them into a confident 'yes.' He notes he receives a flood of coaching requests around the third week of school from teachers whose classes have already spiraled out of control, arguing it is far harder to fix a struggling class than to establish one correctly from day one. The article closes by tying full commitment across all fourteen questions to building the 'dream class' a teacher wants.

quotes: To help ensure you begin the school year on the right classroom management foot, I compiled a list of questions.
I recommend initially running through the questions quickly, answering with your gut instinct.
Am I 100% committed to following my classroom management plan as it’s written?
Every year I get a flurry of emails and coaching sign-ups beginning the third week of school from teachers desperate to know how to rein in an out of control class .
It’s definitely possible, even if their class is in open rebellion. But it’s a far greater challenge than getting it right the first time.
Because once you can answer yes to all fourteen questions, you’re ready to mold your new group of students into the dream class you really want.
